snippet.title: WHAT THE CAR? Steam Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
RUN to Steam and buy now !!!! 
Steam Page: https://bit.ly/WHAT_THE_CAR 

An absurdly silly adventure full of racing, laughs, and unexpected surprises. Roll, sprint, jump, fly and sneeze your way to victory on the racetrack and beyond!

“One of the best games you'll play this year”
- Engadget

“It looks darn great, it sounds wacky as hell, and is about as much fun as I’ve had with a game this year”
9/10 – GodIsAGeek

“Take a joyride (emphasis on joy) through the utterly ridiculous and undeniably delightful world”
5/5 – Saving Content

#pcgaming #whatthecar #steam #steamgames #silly
